emerald_ref4_drift_vs_stage0_9h19m.interpretation: Observed change over +9h 19m across the N = 4 unchanged physical reference circuits on IQM Emerald is -0.0184 +/- 0.0138 F_B (two-sided paired p = 0.2756 across N = 4 circuits, 512 shots/circuit).

confounding_and_scope_disclosure.fresh_vs_stale_arm_definition: In Stage 2B, the 'Fresh' arm uses Prometheus telemetry-ranked subgraph selection and routing compiled against the live calibration snapshot on emerald/garnet, whereas the 'Stale' arm uses Qiskit SABRE O3 on an uncalibrated geometry-only subgraph. This comparison (+0.0418 F_B on emerald, +0.0634 F_B on garnet) therefore measures the combined benefit of telemetry-aware subgraph selection plus Prometheus routing over geometry-only SABRE O3, not isolated temporal calibration aging.
confounding_and_scope_disclosure.pure_temporal_drift_control: Pure temporal hardware drift over +9 hours 19 minutes on IQM emerald is isolated by the 4 Unchanged Physical Reference Circuits (Ref4: identical compiled circuits and physical qubits executed in Stage 0 job 01a1b67e-a782-76aa-9bf4-e10cacf2ab61 at 14:11 UTC and Stage 2B job 01a1b859-bd7d-7423-b970-de01709929e2 at 23:30 UTC), which measured -0.0184 F_B (0.9262 -> 0.9078).

stage3_iqm_duration_mismatch.statistical_methodology_note: In Stage 3B on IQM Emerald (01a1b85a-f7ea-70b1-baaf-ba5e17e92178), M3 (4 PUBs), M4 (4 PUBs in G00..G03), and M5 (4 PUBs in G00..G03) have K = 4 disjoint physical-PUB clusters (df = 3). However, M1 packed the 8 Short workloads into only K = 2 physical 4-Way PUBs (M1_IQM_SS_0 for G00+G01, M1_IQM_SS_1 for G02+G03) and M2 packed the 8 Long workloads into K = 2 physical 4-Way PUBs (M2_IQM_LL_0, M2_IQM_LL_1). Therefore, when accounting for shared physical-PUB execution in M1 and M6, there are only K = 2 completely independent physical-PUB clusters (C0 and C1, df = 1). Both physical-PUB clusters show positive M1 vs M4 wait-loss recovery (+0.0088 F_B in C0 and +0.0426 F_B in C1 across all M4 pairings, mean +0.0257 F_B = 59.7% recovery; or +0.0154 F_B in C0 and +0.0351 F_B in C1 vs disjoint M4 G00..G03, mean +0.0252 F_B), but with K = 2 clusters (df = 1, t_crit_95 = 6.314), formal statistical certification is withheld (1-sided superiority p = 0.1850 / 0.1187 at K = 2, df = 1; vs. p = 0.0488 under unclustered N = 8 workloads).

completed_experiments: Phase 1 (22/22 jobs DONE, 617 PUBs, 538,112 physical shots, 149.0s IBM + 47.25 IQM credits): Stage 0 pilot, Stage 1A/1B 6-policy unseen queue comparison, Stage 2A/2B multi-window and cross-QPU routing across ibm_kingston, ibm_fez, ibm_marrakesh, emerald, and garnet, Stage 3A/3B duration-mismatch experiments, Stage 4A/4B fixed-shot 4x spatial-replica comparison, and Stage 5A live fault/failover and timeout reconciliation.

Phase 2A (12/12 standalone policy jobs DONE, 143 PUBs, 125,952 physical shots, 43.0s IBM Account C + 14.25 IQM credits): Directly billed standalone policy jobs in randomized order under hard submission caps (28 PUBs IBM, 8 PUBs IQM).

Phase 2D (10/10 prospective shot-ladder + independent confirmation jobs DONE, 240 PUBs, 233,472 physical shots, 42.0s IBM Account C + 41.25 IQM credits): Fresh prospective shot rungs (256, 512, 1024, 2048) plus independent 1,024-shot confirmation job, reporting both predeclared stopping-rule cost-to-target and actual full-ladder campaign expenditure.

Phase 2C (3/3 disjoint shared-PUB cluster jobs DONE, 110 PUBs, 84,992 physical shots, 18.0s IBM Account B + 15.75 IQM credits): K = 8 (df = 7) strictly disjoint 8-workload clusters on ibm_kingston and K = 6 (df = 5) 4-Way / K = 12 (df = 11) 2-Way strictly disjoint clusters on emerald with zero workload reuse.

Phase 2B (2/3 jobs DONE on IQM emerald & garnet, 80 PUBs, 40,960 shots, 14.25 IQM credits; 1/3 job dboalms4148s73927590 QUEUED on IBM ibm_kingston, 56 PUBs, 57,344 shots): 4-arm calibration freshness vs. donor/geometry factorial with Q_B4(w) == Q_B2(w) enforced across 100% of workloads.
documented_departures_from_plan: Phase 1 Stage 1 Budget Cutoffs vs. Phase 2A Standalone Jobs: Phase 1 evaluated 30-PUB (IBM) and 8-PUB (IQM) limits as post-hoc cutoffs with pro-rata job costs; Phase 2A resolved this by executing 12 standalone policy jobs with separate provider billing under randomized order.

Phase 1 Stage 2 Joint Compiler+Placement vs. Phase 2B 4-Arm Factorial: Both previously pending Phase 1 cross-QPU jobs (ibm_fez and ibm_marrakesh) completed and are harvested; Phase 2B added a 4-arm factorial separating same-QPU calibration freshness (B4 - B3), compiler routing on identical physical qubits (B4 - B2 with Q_B4 == Q_B2 enforced), and live vs. geometry/donor subgraph placement (B2 - B1). Both IQM Phase 2B jobs (emerald and garnet) are DONE; the IBM Phase 2B job (dboalms4148s73927590) is currently QUEUED on ibm_kingston.

Phase 1 Stage 3 Shared-PUB Clusters vs. Phase 2C Disjoint Clusters: Phase 2C expanded the shared-PUB cluster count to K = 8 (df = 7) on IBM and K = 6 (df = 5, 4-Way) / K = 12 (df = 11, 2-Way) on IQM with zero workload reuse, certifying both IBM M1 vs. M0a non-inferiority (p_NI = 3.1e-5) and IQM M1 vs. M4 wait-loss recovery superiority (two-sided p = 0.0163 for 4-Way, p = 0.0052 for 2-Way).

Phase 1 Stage 4 Fixed-Shot Replica Comparison vs. Phase 2D Prospective Shot Ladder: Phase 2D executed all 4 prospective shot rungs (256, 512, 1024, 2048) plus an independent 1,024-shot confirmation job across 10 hardware jobs, explicitly reporting both Predeclared Stopping-Rule Cost-to-Target and Actual Full-Ladder Campaign Expenditure.
